stage1.impression: A warm, moody timber-and-concrete bar with a good long-room depth and believable fir ceiling, but it reads as a competent CG visualisation rather than a night photograph: the translucent double-exposed ghosts at the counter, the daylight-like bright patches on the concrete wall, and the large blank glowing frames on the right pull the eye, while EARF's pair at the far end is tiny and blown to white rather than read as smoked acrylic. The 1.25 m Mother EARF globe is the one thing that makes this a specific place, but it reads as a dark wire cage, not 25 mm cast acrylic with glowing edges; as it stands a magazine would see a well-made generic warm bar, not yet a specific place.

blocking_9: EARF's altar pair must read as smoked tinted acrylic with no clipped faces (clip_pct < 0.5 on each speaker) and be the brightest-contrast object at the end of the room, not out-lit by the right wall
The frosted screens and the concrete wall on the right must sit below the altar in brightness (median <= 80 vs speakers ~70-100)
Mother EARF must read as thick acrylic: polished disc edges catching light, its shadow on the wall reading as a lamp-thrown pattern, not daylight through a window
Blurred people must read as long-exposure motion (one directional smear), not translucent overlapping double copies
The floor must read as one continuous polished concrete slab with no flagstone crackle pattern and no hard dark polygon shadows
The milky haze veil over the counter must clear so the bar top, glasses and records hold contrast

defects.what: left altar speaker face clipped (3.17 %), reads white/cream, the Smoke tint is lost
right altar speaker face near-clipped and half hidden by a blurred figure
large frosted screen glows flat lavender-grey at median 117, the brightest large surface in the frame, reads as a blank lightbox
hard bright shadow patches from Mother EARF's spot read as moonlight/daylight through a window, incoherent with a night room
Mother EARF reads as a dark wire cage; disc edges do not glow, p95 only 56
counter people rendered as translucent overlapping ghosts with orange blob heads; reads as CG motion blur, not a long exposure
banquette figures are smeared grey ghosts partly transparent over the banquette
floor shows a flagstone/crackle pattern and sharp dark polygon shadows; foreground floor hot (p95 201), reads as tiled texture
milky haze veil over the counter and record wall flattens contrast
counter stools are identical repeated copies in a regular row
visible fine grain/noise at 1:1 across the concrete wall and floor

changes.problem: The altar spots blow the speaker fronts to white so EARF's pair reads as white boxes, not smoked acrylic.
changes.expected: Speaker faces hold tone, the smoke tint and horn read, still the brightest pool at the far end.

changes.problem: The frosted screens on the right are the brightest large surface and pull the eye away from the altar.
changes.expected: Screens become a soft frosted glow below the altar, right wall drops into the low key.

changes.problem: Mother EARF's hard spot throws bright patches on the concrete that read as daylight through a window.

evidence.measured: lum_p95 182.8, median 93.8 on the wall patches

changes.expected: The shadow reads as a lamp-thrown slotted pattern at night, dimmer than the bar's pools.

changes.problem: Mother EARF reads as a dark wire cage, not 25 mm cast acrylic: its disc edges do not catch light.

evidence.measured: lum_median 17.5, lum_p95 55.6; edges barely brighter than the discs at 2x crop

change.setting: materials' finish: Mother EARF disc edges (acrylic roughness)

changes.expected: Thin bright lines along the disc rims and clean reflections, reading as thick polished acrylic.

changes.problem: The blurred people render as translucent overlapping double copies with orange blob heads, a CG tell.

evidence.measured: seen at 2x: three superimposed see-through figures, heads as separate orange discs

change.from: shutter 1.0 frame, head travel [0.2, 0.12, 0.03] m, turn 35 deg
change.to: shutter 0.5 frame, head travel [0.08, 0.05, 0.02] m, turn 15 deg; counter people 3 -> 2

changes.expected: Bodies mostly opaque with one directional smear at heads and hands, faces unreadable, like a quarter-second exposure.

changes.problem: The floor reads as a tiled flagstone texture with hot glossy patches near the camera.

evidence.measured: lum_p95 201.2, median 56.6; crackle/polygon pattern and hard dark polygon shadows at 2x crop

changes.expected: One continuous honed slab, soft pools under the tables, foreground floor no longer the brightest surface.

changes.problem: A milky haze veil over the counter and record wall flattens contrast on the bar top and glasses.

evidence.measured: lum_median 92, lum_p5 32.1 (no deep shadow inside the bar zone)

change.setting: haze in the room's air: density

changes.expected: Bar top and records regain shadow depth, beams still faintly visible.

changes.problem: The frame sits at the top of the night band, more dusk than night, once the above are applied.

change.to: 4.4 (only if the frame median is still above 45 after c1-c7)

changes.expected: Low key with the speaker, bar top and tables still legible.

out_of_scope.request: Make the altar pair larger in the frame or bring a speaker closer to camera
out_of_scope.why: The frame is the from-the-door view with the room's layout fixed; the speakers are ~5 % of the frame wide, so they cannot be the at-a-glance hero here. A tighter companion frame would carry that.

out_of_scope.request: Vary the counter stools and table chairs so they are not identical copies
out_of_scope.why: The seats are fixed by the room's design; only their small props can change.

out_of_scope.request: Give Mother EARF its own glow so it lights the room
out_of_scope.why: It is specified unlit Smoke acrylic; only its finish and the spot may change.
